name: gmixup
setup: python -c "from torch_geometric.datasets import TUDataset; [print(n, len(TUDataset('./' + n, name=n))) for n in ('IMDB-BINARY', 'IMDB-MULTI')]" && python -c 'import cv2, skimage, torch_scatter, torch_sparse, torch_geometric; print(cv2.__version__, skimage.__version__, torch_geometric.__version__)' && ls /work /work/IMDB-BINARY/IMDB-BINARY; echo GCN-CHECK; python -u ./src/gmixup.py --data_path . --model GCN --dataset IMDB-BINARY --epoch 3 --log_screen True 2>&1 | tail -4
smoke: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; mkdir -p out; S=$(( $(printf %s "$RUN_TAG" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 100000 )); K=1; A='--lr 0.01 --batch_size 128 --num_hidden 64 --epoch 800 --aug_ratio 0.15 --aug_num 10 --ge USVT'; t0=$(date +%s); for k in $(seq 0 $((K-1))); do s=$((S + 10000*k)); for ds in IMDB-BINARY IMDB-MULTI; do for gm in False True; do ( t=$(date +%s); python -u ./src/gmixup.py --data_path . --model GIN --dataset $ds --gmixup $gm --seed $s --log_screen True --lam_range '[0.005,0.01]' $A > out/${ds}_${gm}_$k.log 2>&1; echo "$ds $gm seed=$s wall_s=$(( $(date +%s) - t ))"; tail -1 out/${ds}_${gm}_$k.log ) & done; done; wait; done; echo cell_wall_s=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 )); grep -a -h -e 'real aug ratio' -e 'num_features' -e 'train_dataset size' -e 'lam:' out/*.log | head -20; bash gf_harness/emit.sh
